topic: 接收器集成与通知模板
title: 真实接收器更名去重边界：同一告警和groupKey仍可能再次通知，不代表新事故
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 路由/接收器标识与通知历史组织有关，更名可能被视为新的投递路径并重新通知。

conversion.original_title: receiver名称变化为何可能影响通知去重体验？

body:
## 操作任务
实现rename_receiver(config,old,new)：深拷贝，只把恰好一个old接收器定义名称改为未使用的new，并递归更新route中显式等于old的receiver；不为继承路由新增字段，不变更其他接收器/配置/原输入。old/new必须不同的非空字符串，old唯一且new未使用，否则ValueError。真实Alertmanager先证明同一接收器下重复提交相同firing告警被去重；再对参考更名结果在同一进程热重载，保持告警标签/注解/startsAt和group_by不变，确认新receiver再次收到同一groupKey、fingerprint和startsAt的告警。说明这是通知去重接收器身份变化，不能当成新事故，也不能承诺更名无重发；业务侧幂等需按自己的事件合同另行验收。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
官方Alertmanager0.28.1 Windows原生进程、真实去重缓存及回环Webhook、同PID重载。未修改生产接收器、未发外部消息，没有声称跨版本升级、集群分区、业务工单平台的幂等已验证。只证明本题单实例同类webhook接收器更名边界，不能从groupKey单独推断新事故。自有临时配置和进程，不改默认身份或服务，不构建镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,datetime,json,pathlib,shutil,socket,subprocess,tempfile,threading,time,urllib.request,urllib.error
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
import task
binary=shutil.which("alertmanager") or shutil.which("alertmanager.exe")
assert binary and "0.28.1" in subprocess.check_output([binary,"--version"],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5)
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
seen=[]
class Hook(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def do_POST(self):
  seen.append(json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))));self.send_response(200);self.send_header("Content-Length","0");self.end_headers()
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
server=ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),Hook);thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
def request(method,url,payload=None):
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else (b"" if method=="POST" else None),method=method,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"})
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=3) as r:return r.status,r.read().decode()
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:return e.code,e.read().decode()
def wait_for(condition):
 end=time.monotonic()+7
 while time.monotonic()<end:
  if condition():return
  time.sleep(.05)
 raise AssertionError("native receiver rename notification witness missing")
proc=None
try:
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-receiver-rename-") as temp:
  root=pathlib.Path(temp);config={"route":{"receiver":"old-team","group_by":["alertname"],"group_wait":"0s","group_interval":"1s","repeat_interval":"1h","routes":[{"receiver":"other-team","matchers":["team=other"]}]},"receivers":[{"name":"old-team","webhook_configs":[{"url":"http://127.0.0.1:"+str(server.server_port)}]},{"name":"other-team"}]};original=copy.deepcopy(config)
  path=root/"config.json";path.write_text(json.dumps(config),encoding="utf8")
  with socket.socket() as s:s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0));port=s.getsockname()[1]
  base="http://127.0.0.1:"+str(port)
  with (root/"native.log").open("wb") as log:
   proc=subprocess.Popen([binary,"--config.file="+str(path),"--storage.path="+str(root/"data"),"--web.listen-address=127.0.0.1:"+str(port),"--cluster.listen-address=","--log.level=error"],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   try:
    def ready():
     if proc.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError("NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: receiver rename startup")
     try:return request("GET",base+"/-/ready")[0]==200
     except OSError:return False
    wait_for(ready)
    now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);alert={"labels":{"alertname":"PrivateReceiverRename","instance":"owned-host"},"annotations":{"summary":"same incident throughout"},"startsAt":now.isoformat(),"endsAt":(now+datetime.timedelta(minutes=5)).isoformat()}
    request("POST",base+"/api/v2/alerts",[alert]);wait_for(lambda:len(seen)==1)
    first=copy.deepcopy(seen[0]);assert first["receiver"]=="old-team"
    request("POST",base+"/api/v2/alerts",[alert]);time.sleep(1.2);assert len(seen)==1,"same receiver should still deduplicate unchanged firing set"
    print("NATIVE_ALERTMANAGER_SAME_RECEIVER_SAME_FIRING_SET_REPOST_REMAINS_DEDUPLICATED",flush=True)
    print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: rename receiver while preserving real alert and grouping identities",flush=True)
    fixed=task.rename_receiver(config,"old-team","new-team")
    path.write_text(json.dumps(fixed),encoding="utf8");pid=proc.pid;assert request("POST",base+"/-/reload")[0]==200
    request("POST",base+"/api/v2/alerts",[alert]);wait_for(lambda:any(p["receiver"]=="new-team" for p in seen))
    second=next(p for p in seen if p["receiver"]=="new-team")
    assert proc.poll() is None and proc.pid==pid
    assert first["groupKey"]==second["groupKey"] and first["groupLabels"]==second["groupLabels"]
    a,b=first["alerts"][0],second["alerts"][0]
    assert a["fingerprint"]==b["fingerprint"] and a["labels"]==b["labels"] and a["startsAt"]==b["startsAt"] and a["status"]==b["status"]=="firing"
    expected=copy.deepcopy(original);expected["receivers"][0]["name"]="new-team";expected["route"]["receiver"]="new-team"
    assert fixed==expected and config==original
    try:task.rename_receiver(config,"old-team","other-team")
    except ValueError:pass
    else:raise AssertionError("receiver name collision accepted")
    print("NATIVE_ALERTMANAGER_RECEIVER_RENAME_RENOTIFIES_SAME_GROUPKEY_FINGERPRINT_STARTSAT_SAME_PID_NOT_NEW_INCIDENT",flush=True)
   finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:proc.terminate()
    try:proc.wait(timeout=4)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait(timeout=4)
finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(timeout=2)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
